text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks B, E and C at gains felt good, but I should judge each holding by its prospects and risk—not just whether it is above my average cost.","My account value moved both down and up in months when I made no trades; short-term changes alone are not a reason to act.","Past price moves do not predict future ones, so I should avoid treating recent gains or losses as reliable signals when deciding whether to buy, sell or hold."]}
